# Progress Meter

Accessible horizontal progress bar built on the native <progress> element. Use as a report column (partial) or as a list of labelled bars (report).

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_PROGRESS_METER` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/progressMeter` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column), report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.1 |

Shows a value against a maximum. Map Value to a numeric column; non-numeric values render an empty bar instead of breaking the page. State colors the bar with the theme palette.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | Label | sessionStateValue |  |  | Visible caption above the bar. Also used as the accessible name of the progress bar. |
| `value` | Value | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Current numeric value, for example 42. Use a plain number with a period as decimal separator. |
| `max` | Maximum | sessionStateValue |  | `100` | Value that represents a full bar. Defaults to 100. |
| `valueText` | Value Text | sessionStateValue |  |  | Formatted value shown next to the label, for example 42% or 8 of 12 tasks. Leave empty to hide. |
| `state` | State | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional per-row state: success, warning, danger or info. Anything else uses the primary color. |
| `size` | Size | selectList (`small`, `large`) |  |  | Bar thickness. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/progress-meter/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_progress_meter.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
